name: London Project shared Coupang Partners policy
selection_principles: The category counts are flexible guidance, not hard quotas; the total of ten unique product cards is mandatory.
The first two selections should be the most naturally relevant to the article title and subject.
Prefer verified account-generated affiliate links and official product image creatives.
Favor familiar, broadly useful, easy-to-understand, lower-friction products; use observed sales/popularity data only when actually available.
Do not claim a sales ranking when only search-result ordering or a product pool is available.
Fill missing category slots with the strongest available verified products; never invent links, images, prices, sales figures, or products.
Do not repeat the same product URL in one post.

Exactly ten unique verified products with usable official images are mandatory for every new post. If a site catalog has fewer than ten, block that post from publication and report the missing catalog coverage; never publish a partial block or fabricate cards.
Keep affiliate disclosure visible and links marked sponsored nofollow noopener.
